setup: Fresh device per case; route MIDI directly, neutral pitch, disable filter and optional modulation; no tuning system. Unless stated, use 120 BPM, sample and engine 48000 Hz, no effects. Observe source-file hashes before/after file operations. Tests are plans, no Live/candidate executed.

comparators.state: Exact named state/value/list count comparison; displayed units, no assumed XML enums.
comparators.source-identity: Identify deliberately separated source bands/segments, or the documented UI selection. Reject an observation if source identity is ambiguous; no waveform/latency tolerance inferred.
comparators.presence: With an explicitly neutral, sustained setup, compare sustained versus released sound at a point before sample end and after release/fade. No universal loudness threshold or release curve is asserted.
comparators.unknown: Record data only. Expected outcome and acceptance oracle unknown; cannot pass.
